description.text: In a small, quiet shop interior,

, sorting a short stack of receipts. The counter is worn, its edge softened and marked by years of use, and the space around it feels close and still. He wears a plain shirt with the sleeves rolled slightly back, and his posture is relaxed but attentive. Soft, neutral daylight enters from the left, catching the grain of the wood and the pale paper in his hands while leaving the back of the shop in gentle shadow. At first his attention stays on the receipts; then he lifts his head toward an off-screen customer, his shoulders settling and his hands coming to rest flat on the counter. He speaks one short English line to the customer in a flat, even delivery, his mouth and jaw moving with the words. The room stays quiet around him: a low interior room tone and a faint paper rustle continue beneath the voice. After the line, his expression remains composed, and he keeps his gaze on the customer as the moment holds.
